articles.title: Trump’s AG Nominee Hangs in Balance as $1.8B Fund Flips from 'Dead' to Alive
articles.summary: President Trump revived a controversial $1.8 billion 'Anti-Weaponization Fund' on Saturday, threatening to keep Todd Blanche as acting AG if two GOP senators block his confirmation. The fund, which also granted Trump immunity from tax audits, had been declared 'dead' just a day earlier.

articles.title: Moroccan Rapper Mehdi El Youbi Released Pending Trial, but Prosecution Continues
articles.summary: Mehdi El Youbi, a politically outspoken Moroccan rapper, was granted provisional release after 18 days in Casablanca's Oukacha Prison. He still faces charges under Article 179 for 'insulting a constitutional institution,' with a potential two-year sentence.

articles.title: Infantino Under Siege: UEFA and Concacaf Demand Leadership Review at FIFA
articles.summary: FIFA president Gianni Infantino faces mounting criticism after withdrawing a controversial plan to sell stakes in competitions. UEFA and Concacaf issued scathing statements, accusing him of broken promises and calling for a 'full review' of his leadership ahead of his re-election bid.
